'''The Black Nova Tapcafe''' was a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] owned and operated by [[Sherbin Tork]]. Tork described his clientele as rough, the drinks were not [[Water/Legends|watered]] down, and the prices were considered to be fair.<ref name="SWTSE" />
